name: dbsnp
description: dbSNP's VCF for this genome's build, with its sequence names rewritten from RefSeq accessions to the names this genome uses, a tabix index, and a record of the fetch. The tag is the dbSNP build. NCBI publishes the file with names such as NC_000001.11, which no genome in a vault uses; each was replaced through NCBI's assembly report for the build, and only where this genome's sequence of that name has the length the report gives. Nothing else in a record was changed, and a record on a sequence this genome lacks keeps its published name. The result was then checked against this genome's sequence names and lengths like any other resource (bin/prepare_resource.py). The provenance file gives the checksums of the file as published, verified against NCBI's md5, the report used, and how many records were renamed.

required_files.description: the fetch record and compatibility summary

required_assets.description: the genome whose coordinates the variants are in
